paite: Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn a,
heading: Zawlnei Taklou Pasalte Kalh A Thugen

paite: "Mihing tapa, Israel zawlnei, amah lungtang kia a kipan a gen chingte tung ah thu gen inla, 'TOUPA thu ngai un.' "
Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi, "Zawlnei hai, amau ngaihdan zui a, bangmah muloute tung agik hi!
Aw Israel, na zawlneite khopi sesa a sehal om bang lel ahita uh.
TOUPA ni a kidouna a dingzou ding a kulhbaang dingkipsak ding leh Israel inkote hum ding a kulhbaang lam ding in na paitou kei uhi."
"TOUPA thupawt ahi," chi mite'n bangmah lou lel leh genkholhna lim lel atang ua, TOUPA sawl ahi kei uh; athu uh hi ngei ding bang in mite agingtasak ua.
Kilakna hong vuaksuak lel na mu un, thugenkholh diklou na gen uh ahi kei maw? "TOUPA thupawt ahi," na chi nawn ngal ua, ke'n ka gen a hia?
Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Bangmah lou phet na gen ua zuau lel na muh ziak un, ngai un, ka hon nang ahi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.

Huan ka khut in bangmah lou mute leh zuau genkhol mite anang ding a, ka mite kidotkhawmna ah atel kei ding ua, Israel inkuante min gelhna ah gelh in a-om sam kei ding uh; huchi in Toupa PATHIAN ka hi chih na thei ding uh.
Galmuanna omloupi ma, "Muanna," chi a mite apimang ziak un leh mi baang bawl a, sunu nuh mite'n,
"Ake nawn mai ding, vuahpi ahong zu ding a, nou gial lianpite aw, na hong ke ding ua, huih thupi in ahihse ding," chi in.
Ngai un, baang achip khit chiang in, "Na sunu nuh uh koi ah, ahon chi kei ding ua hia?"
"Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ka heh in huihpi thupi in ka hihse vek ding, ka heh in vuahpi ahong zu ding a, ka heh in gial thupitak hihmang ding in ahong ke ding.

Huchi in sunu na nuhngou bang uh ka chimsak ding a, lei pha in achim dia, huchi in asuangphumte adawk hial ding hi; huan achim ding a, baang kichim ah hihmang in na om ding uh; huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh.
"Hichibang in baang tung ah leh sunu nuh mite tung ah ka hehna ka damsak ding; huan, baang a-om nawn kei a, abaang zutte leng a-om nawnta kei uh, ka hon chi ding hi.
Huai bel Israel zawlnei Jerusalem tungthu gen a, galmuanna omloupi a galmuanna musak mite ngei, a-om nawn kei uh, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
"Nang mihing tapa, na mite tanute, alungtang lel ua gen mite masuan inla, amaute kalh in thu gen in, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi:
heading: Numei Zawlnei Dikloute Kalh A Genkholhna

paite: Numei, mite ban a sik bunsak leh mi hinnate mat belhna ding a miliante lukhuhna khui mite atung uh agik hi! Nou hinna ding in ka mite hinna na man ding uh maw?
Buhman tawmchik leh tanghou them mu ding a si lou ding sisak ding leh hing lou ding hingsak ding in na zuaugen uh ka mite'n a-up ziak un ka mite lak ah ka min athanghuai ahi.

"Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai un, mi hinna, vasa bang a man ding a na thil butsakte uh ka mudah ahi; na bante uh ka bot ding a, na mimat dingte uh vasa bang a na mat dingte uh hinna ka pawtsak vek ding hi.
Na lukhuhnate uh leng ka botkek ding a, ka mite na khut ua kipan ka suaktasak ding, na mat theih ding un na khut uah a-omta kei ding uh; huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh.
"Kei lungkhamsak hilou a, midiktatte lungtang zuau a na hihnat ziak un leh migilou hingdam a a-omna ding a akhelhna lampi a kipan akilehheilouhna ding in migilou khutte na hihhat uh ahi.

Huaiziak in bangmah lou lel, thugenkholh diklou hiam zaw na mu nawn kei ding uh; huan na khut ua kipan ka mite ka hunkhe ding a, TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh, achi, chi in gen in," achi high in," achi hi.
